Priya (SecOps): Postmortem live: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/authz-token-gap-1803701122 — assigning remediation leads. Reply with ticket IDs + short acceptance criteria.
Alice C: I'll take token validation + CI enforcement. Ticket INF-5310 created. ETA: 2026-04-06. Acceptance: CI fails when validation missing; staging + canary covered.
Ben R: I'll own permission cleanup. INF-5311. ETA: 2026-04-01. Acceptance: permissions diff + removal of 10+ stale grants, rollback plan documented.
Marco L: Audit logging gaps are on me. INF-5312. ETA: 2026-04-08. Acceptance: missing event types emitted, retention policy set, and alerting for dropped events.
DevOps Oncall: Secrets rotation runbook + infra job. INF-5313. ETA: 2026-04-15. Acceptance: automated rotation job merged, dry-run + verification steps in runbook.
Priya (SecOps): Please add a 1-line acceptance criterion here (so I can paste into the tracker card).
Alice C: INF-5310 | owner: Alice C | due: 2026-04-06 | done: token validation enforced in CI, unit tests for both KV cache hit/miss, canary pass.
Ben R: INF-5311 | owner: Ben R | due: 2026-04-01 | done: permission diff report in repo, stale roles removed, RBAC mapping doc + rollback tested.
Marco L: INF-5312 | owner: Marco L | due: 2026-04-08 | done: audit events added, retention=90d, Grafana panel + an alert for >0 missing-event counters.
DevOps Oncall: INF-5313 | owner: DevOps Oncall | due: 2026-04-15 | done: rotation job in infra, runbook updated, post-rotation healthcheck script present.
incident-bot: Postmortem "AuthZ token validation lapse" added to #incidents and RT board. Card RT-77 created.
Priya (SecOps): Two recurring patterns flagged during the postmortem: stale service tokens after env syncs, and permission drift after vendor deploys. Need automated detection for both.
DevOps Oncall: I'll add a daily scan for token_age exposing a metric `service_token_age_days` and alert when count_over_time(service_token_age_days[24h]) > 5.
Ben R: For drift, I'll prototype a reconcile job that compares declared RBAC in `infra/rbac.yaml` vs runtime grants. If diff != 0 create a ticket + slack notification.
Alice C: Quick test reminder — add unit tests covering fast path (cache hit) and cold path (cache miss) for validation. Also add an integration test that simulates a stale token.
Marco L: Audit logging note: we missed `token.validation.failure` and `permission.denied` events in the original stream — I'll add them and verify with a small script. Example check:
```
# emit a fake failed validation event
curl -X POST $AUDIT_ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" -d '{"event":"token.validation.failure","token_id":"t-123"}'
```
Priya (SecOps): Great. Please link PRs in the INF tickets. I'm scheduling a short remediation checkpoint in the weekly incident sync — 2026-03-31 10:00 PT. If anyone slips update the INF ticket and ping @security-leads.
Ben R: Subscribing to weekly digest for 6 weeks.
Alice C: I'll post a WIP PR today for INF-5310.
Marco L: PR for audit events opened, adding retention config.
DevOps Oncall: INF-5313 draft runbook in infra repo now. Will schedule rotation job after review.
Priya (SecOps): Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with owner rows and move RT-77 to "in progress". If blockers appear, DM me directly. :white_check_mark:
